notes: VerdictToken (src/VerdictToken.sol) is VerdictIMD (VERDICT), an unmodified OpenZeppelin v5 ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 VERDICT (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which on the launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory pays the supply out (the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, economics.poolBps to the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool paired with IMD, the rest to economics.remainderTo). There is no owner, no mint, no burn, no pause, no blocklist, no transfer fee and no transfer hook, so nothing can grow the supply after deployment, no privileged call can move or freeze a holder's balance, and every launch flow moves exactly what it says. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No application contracts are deployed: src/HookFlags.sol and src/LaunchLiquidity.sol are internal libraries inlined into their callers, and src/PoolInitializationGuard.sol is the reserved beforeInitialize-only hook the factory deploys itself, so none of them is a project contract and none holds or is allocated any VERDICT.
